title: Trey Hendrickson sends farewell message to Cincinnati

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Trey Hendrickson sends farewell message to Cincinnati
sources.description: The Bengals are not using a franchise or transition tag on defensive end Trey Hendrickson and that means Hendrickson will be free to move on to another team as a free agent when the new league year gets underway next week.
